name: refinement
description: Refine a user story before development by exposing ambiguities, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies, risks and test scenarios.

interface.longDescription: Challenge and enrich a user story before implementation. Identify missing information, functional rules, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies, risks and useful test scenarios without inventing unresolved business decisions.
defaultPrompt: Refine this user story before development.
Challenge this ticket and identify missing decisions.
Turn this requirement into testable acceptance criteria.
